reapack.name: SGM_CoreUtilities_Bundle.lua
reapack.desc: SGM Studios Essentials: mix bus routing, auto-mastering, smart tools, DAW analyzer, and utilities

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.3.0 (2026-11-07) + SGM_reaper_ultra_hd_smart_tools 2.0.0: the "4K theme generator" claim is gone because it could not be true. A .ReaperTheme holds colours and fonts; artwork lives in the .ReaperThemeZip image stack, which no ReaScript can author, and DPI scaling is REAPER's, not a file's. The generator now inherits your loaded theme and replaces colours in the format REAPER actually parses (32-bit integers, not hex), with every key verified against a published theme. It refuses to edit a zipped theme instead of writing something that loads and looks broken. Contrast is measured and reported rather than "optimised" by a branch that could never run. + Licence: every script now carries an explicit @license MIT line. The repository was already MIT; the individual files did not say so. 1.2.0 (2026-11-07) + SGM_Utils 1.1.0: Utils.load() so every bundle finds the shared library the same way, plus Utils.fx_normalize() which converts a value in a plug-in's own units (-18 dB, 10 ms) into the 0..1 value TrackFX_SetParam actually takes, by reading the plug-in's formatting back. + SGM_auto_master 1.1.0: compressor and limiter settings now land on the documented values (they were being written as if normalized), the ReaEQ high-pass passes its isnorm argument, and the console reports settings it could not apply instead of claiming the chain is configured. + SGM_route_mix_bus 1.1.0: uses the shared message and colour helpers. 1.1.3 (2026-11-07) + daw-discovery-analyzer 1.0.4: no non-existent API calls (GetProjectSampleRate / GetInputChannelCount / GetOutputChannelCount), CPU reports now open REAPER's Performance Meter, and the config monitor publishes its running state to the Action List + SGM_reaper_ultra_hd_smart_tools 1.0.3: the smart-tool engine reports its on/off state to the toolbar and survives an error inside the defer loop 1.1.2 (2026-11-07) + Bug-fix pass: auto-master limiter name + ReaEQ band setup, mix-bus selection/folder handling, analyzer CPU + audio-device keys, smart-tool mouse-modifier safety, Fieldy toggle slot guards + Docs: removed references to toolbar clock / CPU meter / color picker that were never implemented 1.1.1 (2026-10-08) + Top Shelf audit: daw-discovery-analyzer 1.0.1 (GetUserInputs menu, localized functions), SGM_reaper_ultra_hd_smart_tools 1.0.1 (palette fix, mouse-modifier consent/restore, no global exports) 1.1.0 (2026-06-03) + Reorganised for ReaPack: kept to the utilities I use day to day 1.0.0 (2026-05-23) + Initial release

reapack.name: SGM_auto_master.lua
reapack.desc: Auto-mastering chain using REAPER stock plugins: EQ, compression, saturation, and limiting

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.1.0 (2026-11-07) + Fix: compressor / limiter values were written in engineering units (-18 dB, 10 ms) into TrackFX_SetParam, which takes a 0..1 normalized value, so the attack landed nowhere near 10 ms. Values now go through Utils.fx_normalize(), which reads the plug-in's own formatting back and is skipped (with a message) if the plug-in cannot be mapped. + Fix: TrackFX_SetEQParam takes 7 arguments; `isnorm` was omitted, so the high-pass frequency was passed as if it were normalized. + Add: uses the shared SGM_Utils library when it is installed (message output, dB helpers, parameter mapping) and falls back to local helpers when it is not, so this still runs as a standalone file. 1.0.1 (2026-11-07) + Fix: stock limiter is "ReaLimit", not "ReaLimiter" (limiter was never inserted) + Fix: ReaEQ high-pass now uses the documented TrackFX_SetEQParam API instead of writing raw normalized values into the wrong parameter indices + Fix: ReaComp/ReaLimit parameters are located by name instead of hard-coded indices + Add: the HPF_FREQ / COMP_* / LIMIT_CEIL constants that the docs always promised 1.0.0 (2026-06-02) + Initial release

reapack.name: SGM_reaper_ultra_hd_smart_tools.lua
reapack.desc: 4K-friendly REAPER theme generator with WCAG contrast checking and an optional smart-tool cursor engine

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 2.0.0 (2026-11-07) + Fix (honesty): this was described as a "4K theme generator". It cannot be one, and the claims are now gone rather than reworded. A REAPER theme's appearance lives in the PNG stack inside a .ReaperThemeZip; .ReaperTheme holds colours and fonts and nothing else. There is no resolution to generate: REAPER draws at whatever scale the OS says, and the only DPI-related API exposes the *loaded* theme's scaling, it does not set one. The theme this writes uses REAPER's default images, which is exactly what "loads but looks like the default layout" means. + Fix (fatal): the file format was wrong. Colours were written as 6-digit hex like "12243a" and under a "[theme]" section that real theme files do not have. REAPER stores [color theme] values as 32-bit signed integers (col_tl_bg=2302755, col_main_bg=-2143207103), and an unparseable value is silently ignored, so the generated file loaded and changed nothing. + Fix: 12 of the 30 colour keys did not exist (col_tcp_bg, col_mcp_bg, col_item_bg, col_selitem_bg, col_item_fg, editcursor_color, ...). They are renamed to the real keys (col_tcp_text, col_mixerbg, col_mi_bg, mixercol, col_cursor, ...), verified against a published theme and listed in tests/fixtures/theme_keys.txt. + Fix: the generated file had no [REAPER] section, which carries the fonts and ui_img that make a theme a theme. It now copies those from the theme currently loaded, read through GetSetThemeColorVals, so the result is a complete, loadable theme rather than a wall of colour keys. + Fix: "WCAG-checked colours". The contrast maths was right but the branch could never run (the shipped palette is 17.03:1, the threshold was 7), and if it had run it would have made text *darker* (17.03 -> 6.84) - the opposite of its purpose. It now reports measured ratios for several pairs and refuses to alter colours to hit a number. + Fix: the theme is now registered with REAPER via OpenColorThemeFile(), which is the documented way to make a .ReaperTheme visible in Options > Themes. The script still cannot *switch* themes. + Fix: the smart-tool engine's stretch branch tested GetToggleCommandState(1009) as "Alt key". That is not a modifier query; there is no modifier-state API in ReaScript at all. Removed. + Fix: the smart-tool engine no longer claims to change the cursor. It reports the mode it would use, in the console, and changes nothing. + Add: the real DPI scaling REAPER is running at is reported (ThemeLayout_GetLayout "global", -3), instead of a hard-coded guess. 1.0.3 (2026-11-07) + Add: the smart-tool engine reports its on/off state to the Action List (SetToggleCommandState) and refreshes the toolbar, so a toolbar button reflects whether the defer loop is actually running + Fix: the defer loop is wrapped in xpcall; an error in one tick stops the loop and says so instead of silently freezing 1.0.2 (2026-11-07) + Fix: smart tools passed numeric cursor ids to SetMouseModifier(), which only accepts mouse-modifier / action ID strings - it was silently corrupting the user's media-item mouse modifiers. The engine is now opt-in and only ever restores what it saved. + Fix: removed the documented-but-nonexistent "toolbar clock / CPU meter / color picker" tools and the Shift+F12 / Ctrl+Alt+U hotkeys from the docs + Fix: the printed theme path is now reported as "not written" when the file could not be created (was always printed as success) + Fix: WCAG contrast optimization no longer mutates an unverified table 1.0.1 (2026-10-08) + Top Shelf audit: add missing ThemeMetadata.palette (fixes crash in install_theme) + Top Shelf audit: save/restore mouse modifier; confirm before smart tools start + Top Shelf audit: localize functions, remove _G exports (no global leaks) 1.0.0 (2026-06-02) + Initial release

reapack.name: daw-discovery-analyzer.lua
reapack.desc: Profile the REAPER environment: plugins, routing graph, track structure, and system specs

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.0.4 (2026-11-07) + Add: the config monitor reports its on/off state to the Action List (SetToggleCommandState + RefreshToolbar2), so a toolbar toggle shows whether the defer loop is running instead of looking dead 1.0.3 (2026-11-07) + Fix: GetProjectSampleRate / GetInputChannelCount / GetOutputChannelCount are not REAPER API functions (verified against the REAPER 7.83 SDK header). Use GetAudioDeviceInfo("SRATE") and GetNumAudioInputs/Outputs. + Fix: 1.0.2 replaced the non-existent GetCPULoading() with another non-existent function, GetCPUUsage(). REAPER exposes no CPU metric at all, so the report now drives REAPER's own Performance Meter window (action 40364) instead of inventing a number. 1.0.2 (2026-11-07) + Fix: CPU load used the non-existent reaper.GetCPULoading() and crashed the report (superseded by the 1.0.3 correction below) + Fix: audio bit depth queried "BITDEPTH"; the API key is "BPS" + Fix: without SWS, routing edges were reported as "everything -> master"; now uses the built-in P_DESTTRACK API for real send destinations + Fix: SWS detection checked BR_GetMouseCursorContext instead of the routing function actually used (BR_GetMediaTrackSendInfo_Track) + Fix: the config monitor now starts from a captured baseline instead of reporting nothing on the first poll 1.0.1 (2026-10-08) + Top Shelf audit: replace gfx.showmenu with GetUserInputs + Top Shelf audit: localize main functions (no global leaks) 1.0.0 (2026-05-23) + Initial release + System profiling: CPU, RAM, sample rate, buffer size + Plugin discovery and categorization + Signal flow graph generation exported to console

reapack.name: phase-alignment-tool.lua
reapack.desc: Auto-align quad-tracked DI guitars by transient analysis before amp processing

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 2.0.0 (2026-11-07) + Rewrite: alignment is now measured by normalized cross-correlation of the actual audio, not by "where the first sample above 0.3 happens to be". The old method reported a first-threshold crossing, which moves with the material's gain and misses anything played softly. + Fix: the analysis buffer was indexed as frame*channels; reaper.new_array is 1-based, so every take was measured one frame early. + Fix: tracks with several items only had their first item examined, and a silent first item made the track look unalignable. + Fix: the correlation analyser compared item *positions* and called that phase, which says nothing about the audio inside the items. + Fix: every track was nudged to the earliest transient, so a single detection error dragged the whole group. Tracks are now aligned to one explicit reference track. + Add: polarity check (reports an inverted track instead of aligning it to the wrong lobe), confidence reporting, and a refusal to move a track when the correlation is too weak to mean anything. + Add: settings persist between runs (ExtState) and option 7 edits them. + Add: uses SGM_Utils when it is installed, falls back to local helpers. 1.0.3 (2026-11-07) + Fix: reaper.GetProjectSampleRate() is not a REAPER API function (verified against the REAPER 7.83 SDK header); the project/device rate now comes from GetAudioDeviceInfo("SRATE") 1.0.2 (2026-11-07) + Fix: early exits (too few tracks / no transients) left UIRefresh disabled and an undo block open — validation now happens before any begin/refresh + Fix: transient detection read a multi-channel buffer as if it were mono 1.0.1 (2026-10-08) + Top Shelf audit: replace gfx.showmenu with GetUserInputs 1.0.0 (2026-05-23) + Initial release

reapack.name: rule-of-30-session-builder.lua
reapack.desc: Build a 48-track industrial/heavy metal session: Drop Bb, 95-110 BPM, massive density

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 2.0.0 (2026-11-07) + Fix (fatal): SetTempoTimeSigMarker() takes 9 arguments and was called with 8, so the tempo landed in the beatpos slot — every session built at ~4 BPM with a 95/110 time signature. The tempo is now read back with Master_GetTempo() and the build aborts if it did not take. + Fix: plugin chains duplicating. TrackFX_AddByName(..., -1) inserts a new instance every run, so options 2-5 three times gave three chains. Chains now skip an FX the track already has. + Fix: the master FX chain stacked a new ReaComp + ReaEQ on every build. + Add: the Rule of 30 preset library (rule-of-30-plugin-presets.lua) is now actually used — options 2-5 apply real stock-FX settings by parameter name, instead of adding bare plugins with no configuration. + Add: SGM_Utils is used when installed (shared trim/db/clamp helpers). + Add: every chain action reports which plugins it skipped or could not find. + Fix: the console claimed "Added chain: X" even when TrackFX_AddByName returned -1. 1.0.2 (2026-11-07) + Fix (fatal): the plugin-aware builder called the `addFX` local before it was declared, so "Build Session" with Compact Mode off raised "attempt to call a nil value (global 'addFX')" + Fix (fatal): CreateTrackSend() can return -1; the send volume/channel setters then errored on a nil send + Fix: the master track is no longer stripped of its master/parent send + Fix: the plugin inventory is read from the directory the script actually lives in (was hard-coded to the REAPER resource root) + Fix: the sidechain send now reuses an existing Kick Out -> Bass send instead of stacking a new one on every run + Fix: an existing tempo/time-signature marker is used instead of adding one + Fix: "Close" (7) is now handled; it used to fall through with no feedback + Fix: sidechain sends reuse an existing Kick Out -> Bass send, guarded against CreateTrackSend() returning -1 + Removed: unused helper parameters and dead locals 1.0.1 (2026-10-08) + Top Shelf audit: undo + PreventUIRefresh on all six actions + Top Shelf audit: replace gfx.showmenu with GetUserInputs 1.0.0 (2026-05-23) + Initial release + 48+ track template: quad guitars, double bass, full drum kit, orchestral layers + Drop Bb tuning, 95-110 BPM range + Bus architecture with parallel compression sends
